# ProfileResolver

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Auth.Profiles.ProfileResolver`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Auth`

## Summary

Resolves which profile to use based on the priority order: 1. Explicit profile name (CLI flag or API parameter) 2. PPDS_PROFILE environment variable 3. Global active profile from profiles.json
